_about: Real WebAuthn responses captured from browsers and authenticators, copied verbatim from the test suite of py_webauthn (Duo Labs), tests/ at commit 44330eb08fd9 of https://github.com/duo-labs/py_webauthn. Used to check server/webauthn.js against data it was not written against. Each entry names the py_webauthn test it comes from. Three Windows Hello captures were transported as standard base64 by the site that recorded them (transportEncoding: "base64"); the tests re-encode those strings to base64url, as browsers send them — the bytes are unchanged.
